        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4728">'dul ba'i mdo'i rnam bshad mdo'i nyi ma'i rgyan</rs> zhes <lb n="225a3"/> bya ba 'di ni ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4311">'dul ba 'dzin pa stan 1 pa <abbr>nam mkha'</abbr> <abbr>rin chen</abbr></rs> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">lung <abbr>rigs</abbr> smra ba grub pa <abbr>seng ge</abbr></rs> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">dka' bcu 'dzin pa <abbr>dpal ldan</abbr> <abbr>seng ge</abbr></rs> ¦ <rs gyi</abbr> <abbr>gtsug gi</abbr> <abbr>nor bu</abbr> <abbr>mkhan chen</abbr> <abbr>rin po che'i</abbr> <abbr>byin gyis</abbr> brlabs shing 'dul ba 'buM sde'i mnga' bdag <rs type="person" ref="db:6821">'dul <lb n="225a5"/> ba mdo rtsa <abbr>ba</abbr></rs><abbr>'i</abbr> tshig don la <abbr>blo gros kyi</abbr> snang ba <abbr>cung zad</abbr> 'ched pa <rs type="person" ref="db:4593"><abbr>dpal ldan</abbr> bla ma</rs>s <abbr>byin gyis</abbr> brlabs <abbr>pa'i</abbr> gdan sa ¦ <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5748">yol <abbr>rin chen</abbr> gling <abbr>gi gtsug</abbr> lag khang</rs> du <hi rendition="#Time">lnga brgya phrag brgyad pa'i drug bcu re 3 pa ¦ sa mo bya ¦ zhi <abbr>ba'i</abbr> lo <note type="editorial">This is a translation of the Sanskrit “saumya”. An epithet of the 43rd year in a rang byung cycle, the sa mo bya lo “Female Earth Bird Year”. From: mkhan rgyud rnam gsum byon tshul gyi rnam thar, f. 24a; Heimbel, “The Jo gdan tshogs sde bzhi: An Investigation into the History of the Four Monastic Communities in Śākyaśrībhadra's Vinaya Tradition” Nepalica-Tibetica: Festgabe for Christoph Cüppers.</note> <!-- TODO add this reference to Zotero? --> <lb n="225a6"/> dbyar zla ra <abbr>ba<anchor xml:id="a3"/>'i</abbr> yar ngo'i tshes 3<anchor xml:id="a4"/></hi> la zin <abbr>bris su</abbr> bkod pa'o || <abbr>mkhan chen</abbr> <abbr>rin po che nas</abbr> 'dis pha mas gtso byas <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>sems can</abbr> <abbr>thams cad</abbr> kyis <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen <abbr>pa'i</abbr> go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig | <abbr>yi ge</abbr> pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4729">shAkya'i <abbr>dge slong</abbr> <abbr>blo gros</abbr> <abbr>seng ge</abbr></rs>'o || <abbr>phyogs</abbr> dus gnas <lb n="225a7"/> skabs <abbr>thams cad</abbr> du <abbr>bkra shis</abbr> par <choice><orig>gyu</orig><reg>gyur</reg></choice> cig | × dge'o || <note type="editorial">There are a few lines of Lantsa before the 'dge'o'</note></seg></TEI>
